title: Curvature at infinity of scalar-flat ALE four-manifolds
summary: We study refined asymptotics of scalar-flat ALE four-manifolds in the Tian--Viaclovsky setting, namely for self-dual or anti-self-dual metrics and for metrics with harmonic curvature. Starting from the ALE coordinates obtained by Tian--Viaclovsky, we construct preferred coordinates at infinity and identify the homogeneous $|x|^{-2}$ term in the metric expansion. This term splits canonically into a scalar part determined by the ALE ADM mass and an algebraic Weyl tensor at infinity.
